description: The classic 7×6 Connect Four — play against a friend locally or challenge a minimax AI that looks 4 moves ahead.

faqs.a: Two Players (local) or Vs Computer, where you play red against a minimax AI with alpha-beta pruning.
The AI looks 4 moves ahead, scoring lines of 2, 3, and 4 while blocking your threats.
Connect 4 of your discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. A full board with no winner is a draw.
Tap a column's ▼ button (or the column itself) to drop your disc into it.
faqs.q: How do I play on mobile?

howto: Tap a column to drop your disc.
Connect 4 in a row — any direction — to win.
The AI moves automatically after you.
title: Connect Four Game
